title: Ghosts of Charity
logline: A massive automated freighter lost its routing database and is aimlessly delivering decades-old humanitarian aid to planets that no longer need it, sparking a race to capture it.

roles.description: Wants to secure the old medical supplies to treat a modern plague.
Just wants to melt the massive ship down for its platinum hull.
A colossal, blind machine blindly carrying out an obsolete mission.
An underfunded organization desperate for resources.
A brutalist scrapping yard built to tear ships apart.
A triage center that desperately needs the freighter's ancient medicines.
An aggressive salvage vessel bristling with cutting lasers.
A cutthroat scavenger ship looking to steal the cargo.

public_situation: A legendary ghost ship, the {role:automated_freighter}, has suddenly appeared in the sector, loaded with millions in obsolete humanitarian aid.
private_truth: The ship's systems is failing, and if it isn't stopped soon, its fusion drive will inevitably detonate.

beats.public_change: The freighter begins dumping crates of perfectly preserved, thirty-year-old medical supplies into deep space.

missions.reason: The pilot must stop scavengers from stealing the dumped medical crates and bring them back.
missions.private_fact: The rival ships are firing wildly and destroying more medicine than they take.

missions.reason: The hunter asks the pilot to scan the freighter's engines to determine if it can be boarded safely.
missions.private_fact: The scan reveals the fusion drive is barely contained and will detonate if breached forcefully.

beats.public_change: The freighter jumps to the next system, trailing a massive radiation cloud.

missions.reason: The pilot must deliver the recovered medical crates to the hospital immediately.
missions.private_fact: The medicines are perfectly viable and save dozens of lives.

missions.reason: The pilot must scan the rival scavenger to determine their boarding capabilities.
missions.private_fact: The rival is prepping explosives that will breach the freighter's containment field by accident.

beats.public_change: The freighter's automation broadcast a final, corrupted plea for new routing coordinates.

missions.reason: The pilot must pay exorbitant fees to acquire an old navigation module from the salvage hunter.
missions.private_fact: The module contains the coordinates to the relief agency's headquarters.

beats.public_change: The freighter's drive begins to critically overheat. It must be redirected immediately before it explodes.

missions.reason: Deliver the module to the hospital so they can guide the ship in and claim the aid.
missions.private_fact: The hospital is risking its own limited power grid to send the massive broadcast.

missions.reason: Deliver the module to the depot so the hunter can force the ship to land in their scrap yard.
missions.private_fact: The hunter knows the landing will heavily damage the freighter, destroying most of the medicine.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot uploads the hospital's coordinates.
resolutions.summary: The freighter limps to the relief agency and safely powers down. Millions in aid are recovered, and the ship's legacy is preserved.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot guided a blind, decades-old ghost ship full of medical aid safely into port.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot uploads the scrap yard's coordinates.
resolutions.summary: The freighter arrives at the yard and is brutally disassembled. The aid is destroyed, but the pilot and the hunter make a fortune.
The freighter's drive goes critical and it detonates, wiping out a huge swath of empty space and destroying all the aid.

loose_threads.detail: The ship's corrupted logs indicate its original routing data was wiped by a commercial mining consortium's override code.
The salvage hunter brags that they already sold the ship's platinum hull to an off-world banking clan before they even caught it.

radio_hooks: Ghost ship spotted dropping ancient medical supplies in the outer rim.
{role:relief_agency} begs for assistance in securing lost humanitarian vessel.

voice_direction.salvage_hunter: Greedy, fast-talking, sees everything as a price tag.
